Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner wrongly assumed that the girls’ variant would have a separate, adjacent Roud number (e.g., 822), whereas Roud indexing typically groups variants under the same number. In this case, both “What Are Little Boys Made Of?” and “What Are Little Girls Made Of?” are under Roud 821. This incorrect assumption diverted the search to 822 (“Sheriff”) and away from confirming 821 for the girls’ rhyme, leading the process off-track.
